evidence.title: feat(core): cap web_search calls per session by qqqys · Pull Request #11852 · QwenLM/qwen-code · GitHub

name: feat(core): cap web_search calls per session (#11852)
summary: Merged pull request adding a per-session cap on web_search tool calls in the Qwen Code agent, plus settings-dialog fixes.
description: Pull request in QwenLM/qwen-code that caps web_search tool calls per session: tools.webSearch.maxPerSession (env WEB_SEARCH_MAX_PER_SESSION, default 200, max 10000) returns a non-error skip at the cap. The counter lives on the root Config, is shared by subagents and resets when the session changes. Also fixes sub-second timeout text, truncation labels and editing of integer settings in the settings dialogs.
contains: non-error skip result; failed searches still count; calls rejected before send do not
counter on root Config shared by subagents, reset on session change
follow-up fixes: sub-second timeout text, truncation label, integer settings in dialogs
